g.text: FAITH ★
pray WITH consent;
clergy welcomed!
SUPPLEMENTS
vitamins? sellers'
miracle pills?
OTHERS
cupping? aroma?
acupuncture?
EVIDENCE CHECK
helps? harms? cost?
delays care?
SCOPE LINE
nurse does / refers /
refuses — know it!
FAITH (Ghana's #1 complementary therapy!): pray WITH consent ("shall we pray before
theatre…?") · clergy WELCOMED (visiting flexed!) · fasting SCHEDULED with drugs · holy
water/oils allowed where harmless · healing SERVICES + treatment together ("both — God
guides the drip!"). Refuse ONLY harm (stopped drugs! chaining! starvation fasts!).
SUPPLEMENTS: vitamins (D? iron? — NUT!) · "miracle" MLM pills (CHECK: FDA? cost? delays?!) ·
protein powders · "blood tonics" (alcohol? sugar? iron real?). Counsel: food FIRST (NUT!),
deficiencies TESTED, sellers' claims VERIFIED, budgets guarded (pills vs school fees!).
OTHERS (know + refer!): CUPPING (hygiene? anaemia? — sterile + screen!) · AROMATHERAPY
(lavender calm? — allergies! asthma!) · ACUPUNCTURE (trained only! sterile needles! — refer,
never DIY!) · chiropractic (neck danger! — refer carefully!) · homeopathy (harmless? delays?).
EVIDENCE CHECK (4 Qs!): does it HELP (what proof?) · does it HARM (direct? delays? cost?)
· does it DELAY needed care (the killer Q!) · can they AFFORD it (vs food/fees/drugs?)?
Help + harmless + affordable = welcome; delays care = negotiate URGENTLY.
SCOPE LINE — NURSE DOES: massage + breathing + relaxation + prayer-with + education +
coordination. REFERS: acupuncture + chiropractic + herbalist-prescribing + intense rites.
REFUSES: chaining/beating + starvation fasts + secret injections + "stop drugs" orders +
anything harming (PRO-I!). Document line + reason.
LINKS: BEH faith/meaning · NUT food-first · PRO-I scope · M05 negotiate.
MANTRA: "welcome the harmless, check the costly, refuse the harmful."
